# Nothing is kept

How sure we are: <span class="tag tag-device">DEVICE</span>

Nothing survives a restart: the exploit and our code live in RAM and vanish at reboot. This is a tethered boot. When
the phone shows a logo, it has left Recovery and must be put back in DFU. Making the boot untethered on this chip is
a hypothesis; the research is written down but nothing has been shown on the phone.
